title: How Much Protein Do You Need?

scenes.fact: The Recommended Dietary Allowance (RDA) for protein is 46g for women and 56g for men.
scenes.text: Most adults need about 1.2 grams of protein daily.
Protein is essential for muscle maintenance and repair, especially for active adults.
